GBR.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

_meta.title: People of African descent (including descendants of enslaved people): UN findings by country
_meta.what: For each country, how many UN human-rights recommendations and observations (from the treaty bodies, the special procedures and the Universal Periodic Review) deal with discrimination against people of African descent, many of them descendants of enslaved Africans, and calls for reparations for slavery, with every matching record listed in full. value = number of matching records. This counts UN attention, not the size of the problem: countries that report more often, or receive more country visits, get more records, and a country with no record may simply not have been reviewed on the issue. A record about several countries is listed under each. year = latest record; first_year = earliest.
_meta.matching_rule: Text mentions African descent, Afro-descendants, Afro-[x] population/community/people, people of African..., descendants of enslaved people/slaves; OR UHRI tags "People of African Descent"; OR the body is the Working Group of Experts on People of African Descent. Field reparations_slavery = the text links reparations to slavery, the slave trade or colonialism. Matching is on the English text of each UHRI record (plus UHRI tags where stated); every record that matches is kept. Field "matched" shows what matched in each record.
_meta.source: Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), Universal Human Rights Index, full dataset export (export-full-en.xlsx, 278244 records, downloaded 2026-10-22)
_meta.licence: OHCHR: dataset shared "freely and without any restriction to the public"
_meta.licence_quote: "OHCHR is willing to share freely and without any restriction to the public the dataset from UHRI" (https://uhri.ohchr.org/en/our-data-api)
_meta.citation: OHCHR, Universal Human Rights Index (uhri.ohchr.org), full dataset export, accessed 2026-10-22.
_meta.note_codes: XKX = Kosovo (UHRI: "Kosovo*"); EUU = European Union (not a country; UHRI lists it as a country concerned).
_meta.document_url_note: document_url is the UN Official Document System link built from the document symbol.
_meta.records_note: This layer was over 4 MB, so each country lists record_ids and the full records (all fields, with text) are in un_african_descent_records.json, keyed by annotation_id, stored once even when a record concerns several countries. No record was dropped.
